mapper.sql: id,org_id orgId,name,pinyin_name pinyinName,wo_guid woGuid,mobile,Mobile_owner mobileOwner,medical_number medicalNumber,gender,age,birthday,origin_type originType,origin_id originId,remarks,inservice,crt_id crtId,crt_name crtName,crt_time crtTime,upt_id uptId,upd_name updName,upd_time updTime
mapper.select: select from patient_base_info where name = #{form.name} and mobile = #{form.mobile}
select count(1) from patient_base_info where mobile = #{mobile}

select pbi.name name,pbi.gender gender,pbi.age age,pbi.mobile mobile, pbi.medical_number medicalNumber,pmi.member_type_id memberTypeId, cast(SUM(pmi.principal_amount+pmi.bonus_amount) as decimal(15,2)) memberCardMoneySum, cast(SUM(ppi.prepayment_principal+ppi.prepayment_bonus)as decimal(15,2)) prepaymentsMoneySum from patient_base_info pbi join patient_prepayments_info ppi on pbi.id = ppi.patient_id join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id where pbi.id = #{id}
select from patient_base_info where CONCAT(name,medical_number,pinyin_name,mobile) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{form.condition}),'%')
select from patient_base_info where name = #{form.name} and mobile = #{form.mobile} and org_id = #{form.orgId}
